meta.prompt: Show me how the product did this month as an inline dashboard with a toggle between 7, 30 and 90 days that changes every number. Four stat tiles with their change, each period: 7 days: revenue $18.4k (+4.1%), sign-ups 312 (+6.0%), churn 2.9% (-0.2%), active users 13,870 (+1.4%); 30 days: $78.9k (+8.5%), 1,340 (+11.2%), 3.1% (+0.4%), 14,260 (+6.3%); 90 days: $221k (+15.3%), 3,905 (+9.8%), 3.4% (-0.6%), 14,260 (+12.1%). A line chart of revenue over the period, and a bar chart of sign-ups by channel (Organic, Paid, Referral, Social, Email) that adds up to the sign-ups: 7 days 128, 84, 52, 31, 17; 30 days 540, 372, 218, 134, 76; 90 days 1,580, 1,010, 640, 420, 255. Under them a table of the top five plans I can sort by any column, starting with revenue, highest first: Pro 1,340 subs, $38,900, churn 2.1%; Team 412, $24,700, 1.4%; Starter 2,980, $8,900, 5.2%; Business 96, $4,800, 0.9%; Student 640, $1,600, 6.8%.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Product dashboard" "Performance this month" icon:"insights" status:"Live" tone:accent
  Segments =range options:["7 days","30 days","90 days"]
  let period = range == "7 days" ? 0 : range == "30 days" ? 1 : 2
  let revenues = [18.4,78.9,221][period]
  let signups = [312,1340,3905][period]
  let churns = [2.9,3.1,3.4][period]
  let activeUsers = [13870,14260,14260][period]
  let revDelta = [4.1,8.5,15.3][period]
  let signDelta = [6.0,11.2,9.8][period]
  let churnDelta = [-0.2,0.4,-0.6][period]
  let activeDelta = [1.4,6.3,12.1][period]
  let channelCounts = [[128,84,52,31,17],[540,372,218,134,76],[1580,1010,640,420,255]][period]
  let revSeries = [[18.4],[78.9],[221]][period]
  state desc=true
  Grid cols:2 gap:10
    StatTile "Revenue" "vs last period" value:"${revenues}k" delta:"{revDelta}%" icon:"payments"
    StatTile "Sign-ups" "vs last period" value:"{signups}" delta:"{signDelta}%" icon:"person_add"
    StatTile "Churn" "vs last period" value:"{churns}%" delta:"{churnDelta}%" invert:true icon:"trending_down"
    StatTile "Active users" "vs last period" value:"{activeUsers}" delta:"{activeDelta}%" icon:"group"
  ChartCard "Revenue" value:"${revenues}k" values:=revSeries labels:["Start","End"] kind:"line" delta:"{revDelta}%"
  ChartCard "Sign-ups by channel" value:"{signups}" values:=channelCounts labels:["Organic","Paid","Referral","Social","Email"] kind:"bars" delta:"{signDelta}%"
  SectionLabel "Top plans" "tap a column to sort"
  TableHeader =sort desc:desc columns:["Plan","Subs","Revenue","Churn"] keys:["plan","subs","revenue","churn"] widths:[1,1,1,1]
  TableRow cells:["Pro","1,340","$38,900","2.1%"] widths:[1,1,1,1]
  TableRow cells:["Team","412","$24,700","1.4%"] widths:[1,1,1,1]
  TableRow cells:["Starter","2,980","$8,900","5.2%"] widths:[1,1,1,1]
  TableRow cells:["Business","96","$4,800","0.9%"] widths:[1,1,1,1]
  TableRow cells:["Student","640","$1,600","6.8%"] widths:[1,1,1,1]
